method: targeted Kyrgyz-English semantic review in adjacent verse context; printed edition source IDs; inventory-142 manuscript alignment remains provisional
checked_by: Codex with parallel agent proposal reviewed by root
uncertainty: Line 30: чок in the damaged-spear description remains provisional.
Line 43: тон көтөрүп is read contextually as a coat bearing the blow; check the printed page and idiom before release.
Line 50: бир тогуз denotes nine guardians in this context, but their exact identity needs specialist review.
Line 59: Казайылын has no verified gloss; current English is plainly wrong but no replacement is offered pending source review.
Line 77: кыялыңдан кыңк этпей is translated contextually and warrants native-speaker review.
Line 59 preserves the source term kazayyl untranslated pending verification.

corrections.reason: момундай means “like this,” not “modest.”

corrections.en: He leveled his spear straight at her,
corrections.reason: беттеп means facing or aiming toward; the source describes a spear attack.
Бенде is a mortal; чыдап тургусуз means impossible to endure.

corrections.en: The great host pressed in around them,
corrections.reason: калың кол is a massed army, not thick hands.

corrections.en: Leaving not a hair’s breadth of respite.
corrections.reason: кылча means a hair’s breadth; такат is endurance or respite.
Preserve epithet and syntax leading into the next line.
момундай means “thus”; кармашканы is his manner of grappling/fighting.

corrections.en: “If this spear of mine truly strikes,
corrections.reason: Sarybay’s direct internal speech begins here.

corrections.old: The angle of the elbow is
corrections.en: It will strike at the elbow,” he thought.
corrections.reason: чыканак is elbow; тушу marks the point/level of attack.

corrections.old: This is the real place to die.
corrections.en: “This is where that mad bitch will truly die,” he thought.
corrections.reason: Make future threat and referent clear without changing abusive source epithet.

corrections.en: Spurring himself on with this thought,
corrections.reason: күүлөнүп is becoming fired up, not tuning music.
одураңдап is rough, blustering movement.

corrections.en: “If I thrust my spear with all my strength,
corrections.reason: чымырканып is straining with effort; найза урсам is a spear thrust.

corrections.en: Will my spear not strike home?
corrections.reason: айза is spear, variant of найза; not cold.

corrections.en: However great a hero she may be,
corrections.reason: The singular opponent is Kuyaly.

corrections.old: Does the head not go into the ground?
corrections.en: Will her head not sink to the ground?”
corrections.reason: Rhetorical future of Kuyaly’s defeat.
оя with ой ойлоп repeats “thought” for emphasis.
көңүл is mind/heart; жай бойлоп is moving calmly, not a path.
Syntactic continuation of thought.
көөдөн is chest/breast; figurative pride, not mountains.
Тоокызыл is Sarybay’s horse, attested in this same episode.
көпкөк means intensely blue; болот means steel.

corrections.en: He thrust forward with a roar.
corrections.reason: күркүрөтө is with a rumbling/roaring sound.

corrections.old: This is where you will die.
corrections.en: “This is where you die,” he said,
corrections.reason: Retain direct speech and threat.

corrections.en: And Sarybay the hero, as you see,
corrections.reason: Narrator’s apostrophe.
күп is impact sound; not “said a lot.”
муштап conveys forceful strike/punch in this spear context.

corrections.en: The spear bent and its tip blunted,
corrections.reason: майышып = bent; айза = spear; чок suggests blunt stump/point. Translation provisional.
Кайыпчалдын кыз арстан: gendered hero epithet.
балбандыгы көрүнүп = strength/prowess becoming manifest.
көк айза is the blue spear, not the moon.
быт-чыт болуп бөлүнүп is fragmentation.

corrections.en: Was protected by the Forty Chiltens.
corrections.reason: кырк чилтен are forty supernatural guardians; retain name.

corrections.old: When struck by a hard spear,
corrections.en: When the mighty spear struck her,
corrections.reason: кыйын here describes the formidable spear.
Preserve established mythic name.

corrections.en: Caught her by the hem and held her up.
corrections.reason: этектеп is to grasp a garment hem; support is inferred from surrounding lines.
берен is a valiant hero; арбак here ancestral spirit.

corrections.en: Stood beside her and supported her.
corrections.reason: жөлөп-таяп means propping/supporting.

corrections.en: The poor girl with the strong back
corrections.reason: жону мыкты = strong-backed; бейбак marks unfortunate person, not insult.

corrections.en: Her coat now bore the blow;
corrections.reason: тон is coat, and context is spear deflected from Kuyaly. Provisional contextual reading.

corrections.old: The ghost of Manas is a mountain
corrections.reason: Тоодой is mountain-like, qualifying Manas.
чоң көтөрүп is great upholding; follows Manas’s spirit.
бакты-таалай ырыс enumerates good fortune/prosperity, not birthday.

corrections.en: Turned their gaze upon her now.
corrections.reason: көзүн салды = set an eye upon; байлап is to bind/attach, a personification.

corrections.old: The most expensive one is forty forty,
corrections.reason: кырк чилтен is a mythic group; not “forty forty.”

corrections.old: Now he leans forward from side to side.
corrections.en: Propped her up from every side.
corrections.reason: туш-туштан = from all sides; жөлөп = supported.
бир тогуз is an epic formula for nine protecting spirits; exact identity uncertain.
колдоп келип = came supporting.
кыз арстан балбан кыз is an epithet for Kuyaly.

corrections.old: The girl who hit the ground
corrections.en: Who had crossed so much ground at a gallop,
corrections.reason: кыйла жерди чапкан = ridden/traversed much land; not struck the ground.

corrections.old: Kyla is a girl who likes people.
corrections.en: Who had pleased so many people,
corrections.reason: кыйла киши жаккан = appealed to many people.
Кызыр is Khizr, legendary supernatural guide; not “red father.”

corrections.old: A girl who cares for the land.
corrections.en: Whom he had watched over across many lands,
corrections.reason: баккан means cared for; parallel to Khizr leading Kuyaly.
кыйшаңдабай былк этпей expresses immobility.

corrections.en: Without a twitch, without a stir,
corrections.reason: күлтылдабай / кылтылдабай conveys no flutter or tremor.
Preserve line; punctuation adjustment only.
кенебей = paying no heed; кылтылдабай = not twitching.
сайганын refers to the spear thrust, not sewing needle.
салмагын көр = see its weight/force; момундай = thus.

corrections.en: She held it in utter contempt,
corrections.reason: бучкагына теңебей idiom: held it as worth nothing.
өдө-ылдый = up and down; карабай = without looking.
Keep simple action and referent.
капырга marks Sarybay as infidel in this episode.
Direct speech follows.

corrections.en: “You stretched out and thrust your spear;
corrections.reason: найза сайдыңыз is spear thrust, not just stretching.
кезек is fighting turn. The possessive кезегимди means “my turn.”

corrections.en: You drew your bow and rained down arrows,
corrections.reason: жаа тартып = drew bow; жамгыр кылып = like rain.
мөндүр кылып = like hail; ок атып = fired projectiles.

corrections.en: And stirred up an ugly battle.
corrections.reason: жаңжал = strife/fight; not an awkward “bad fight.”

corrections.en: You even fired your shots in haste;
corrections.reason: ашыгыраак = more hurriedly.
уят болду мунуңуз is a reproach addressed to Sarybay.

corrections.old: Don't give up on your dreams.
corrections.en: Do not murmur or go back on your word;
corrections.reason: кыялынан кыңк этпей: do not mutter/shift intent; linked to his promise. Provisional.
кыя тартып = pull aside/slant; кылк этпей = without stirring.

corrections.en: Agree to what I have said.
corrections.reason: деген сөзгө көнүңүз = accept the spoken words; Kuyaly’s speech continues next page.

corrections.en: When she held out her kazayyl [term unresolved],
corrections.reason: Preserves the unverified source term rather than inventing “hair”; grammatical action сунганда is held out/extended. Requires source-specialist review.
